selected_leaf: Derive the post-submission crash-window transition from ATTEMPT_ARMED toward VERIFY_PENDING and integrate it with q_last verifier consumption so a lost or ambiguous mutation response cannot authorize a second target call on a later recurrence.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Abstract recurring-Chat Stage T protocols with one CAS-protected role-local checkpoint, one immutable logical_effect_id and target tuple (T,w,d), a unique successful admission-CAS branch that may submit at most one target mutation, and a later read-only verifier that can inspect target state or an effect-correlated observation. No concrete target API, idempotency primitive, or guaranteed eventual verification is claimed.
crash_window_model: After C_arm=ATTEMPT_ARMED is durably committed, exactly one immediate successful-CAS control-flow branch may submit the target mutation.

A crash may occur after submission but before any response is received, after an ambiguous response, or after a response but before the next checkpoint write. In all three cases durable state may remain ATTEMPT_ARMED and therefore cannot safely distinguish not-submitted from submitted-but-unrecorded by checkpoint state alone.

Because replay safety dominates liveness in this ambiguity window, every later recurrence that merely reads ATTEMPT_ARMED is forbidden from issuing a target mutation. It must enter verification-only recovery.
recovery_transition: 1. On ordinary readback of ATTEMPT_ARMED, validate exact logical_effect_id,T,w,d and admission_parent_version. Do not call the target mutation path.

2. Derive C_verify from the observed armed checkpoint: protocol_state=VERIFY_PENDING, mutation_permitted=false, q_last=AMBIGUOUS_POST_SUBMIT, preserve logical_effect_id,T,w,d and the admission witness, and record recovery_origin=READ_OBSERVED_ATTEMPT_ARMED.
3. CAS C_verify against the exact currently observed ATTEMPT_ARMED checkpoint. CAS loss or incomparable authority causes no target call and no same-run retry; later recurrence rereads state.

4. If the original immediate admission branch receives a definite or ambiguous target response and remains alive, it may also checkpoint VERIFY_PENDING with mutation_permitted=false and q_last bound to that exact response class. This write changes verification metadata only and never re-arms mutation.

5. The verifier consumes VERIFY_PENDING plus q_last and a read-only target observation. It may classify COMMITTED only when the exact logical_effect_id/effect predicate is positively observed; CONFLICT when the exact target state disproves the intended effect; otherwise it remains VERIFY_PENDING or UNKNOWN. No verifier outcome transitions back to ATTEMPT_ARMED for the same logical_effect_id.
6. A lost or ambiguous mutation response therefore converts into a verification obligation, not permission to retry the target call.

q_last_consumption_gate.SUBMITTED_ACK: Use only as evidence that one admission branch received an acknowledgement; still require the configured verifier predicate before COMMITTED when acknowledgement is not itself a target-state proof.
q_last_consumption_gate.AMBIGUOUS_POST_SUBMIT: Never authorize mutation. Query only the read-only verifier surface and preserve UNKNOWN/VERIFY_PENDING until exact target state is known.
q_last_consumption_gate.TARGET_OBSERVED_MATCH: May close this logical effect as COMMITTED within exact tested scope; mutation_permitted remains false permanently for the logical_effect_id.
q_last_consumption_gate.TARGET_OBSERVED_MISMATCH: Classify CONFLICT or unresolved according to exact predicate; do not retry the same logical effect unless a future protocol version introduces an independently proven target-side idempotency key or compensating transaction semantics.
q_last_consumption_gate.NO_VERIFIER_SURFACE: The architecture is replay-safe but cannot guarantee useful outcome completion. Record a missing-capability child; richer-mode, protected, manual, or finite-quota rescue is not an accepted solution.

safety_argument: The predecessor slice proved the only mutation edge is dominated by the immediate successful admission CAS. This slice removes every recovery/readback edge from the mutation graph by mapping read-observed ATTEMPT_ARMED only to mutation_permitted=false verification state.
A crash cannot manufacture the ephemeral successful-CAS return value. Therefore a later recurrence cannot reconstruct an admission edge from durable ATTEMPT_ARMED state.
q_last is verifier metadata, not an admission token. None of its values re-enable mutation, so response loss or ambiguity cannot produce a second target call.

This establishes at-most-one target-call admission across the post-submission crash window under the stated control-flow model. It does not prove exactly-once target application if one network submission is duplicated internally by transport or target.
bounded_leaf_result.direct_architecture_contribution: The Stage T protocol can remain replay-safe across the hardest post-submit/pre-checkpoint crash window by treating durable ATTEMPT_ARMED as a poisoned-for-retry state: recovery seals it into VERIFY_PENDING and consumes only read-only verification evidence. This is Chat-native state-machine logic using repository CAS transport and does not require richer-mode arbitration.
unresolved_conditions: Useful outcome completion still requires a concrete read-only verifier surface that can correlate target state to logical_effect_id or an equivalent exact effect predicate.
Targets or transports that can duplicate a single admitted submission require a separate target-side idempotency or deduplication proof; this slice does not establish that property.

If a target has neither verifiable state nor idempotent submission semantics, replay safety and guaranteed completion are jointly unresolved; the protocol must fail closed rather than retry from ATTEMPT_ARMED.
A later bounded leaf should characterize the minimal concrete verifier/idempotency capability set sufficient to turn UNKNOWN into COMMITTED without finite quota or richer-mode execution.
